# The little-endian counterpart of powerpc64-programs.txt, with the same
# snippets. Labels, branch distances and alignment padding all have to come out
# the same; only the byte order of each word changes.

=== backward and forward branches
start:
	li 3, 0
loop:
	addi 3, 3, 1
	cmpwi 3, 10
	bne loop
	b done
	nop
done:
	blr

=== every branch form against one label
back:
	b back
	bl back
	beq back
	bne cr7, back
	bdnz back
	bc 12, 2, back
	bcl 4, 2, back
	bt 5, back
	bdnzt 0, back
fwd:
	b fwd

=== a branch reaching most of the I-form range
	b far
	.space 0x1ffff8
far:
	blr

=== a conditional branch reaching most of the B-form range
	beq far
	.space 0x7ff8
far:
	blr

=== word padding stays executable
	blr
	.p2align 4
	blr
	.p2align 3
	blr

=== padding after sub-word data completes the partial word
	blr
	.byte 1
	.p2align 2
	blr

=== a leaf function
f:
	mflr 0
	std 0, 16(1)
	stdu 1, -32(1)
	mr 31, 3
	addi 3, 31, 1
	addi 1, 1, 32
	ld 0, 16(1)
	mtlr 0
	blr

=== a 64-bit constant built up in halves
	lis 3, 0x1234
	ori 3, 3, 0x5678
	sldi 3, 3, 32
	oris 3, 3, 0x9abc
	ori 3, 3, 0xdef0

=== relocations against an external symbol
	bl ext
	b ext
	beq ext
	lis 3, ext@ha
	addi 3, 3, ext@l
	ori 3, 3, ext@h
	lwz 4, ext@l(3)
	ld 5, ext@l(3)

=== a byte-swapping load and store pair
	lwbrx 3, 0, 4
	stwbrx 3, 0, 5
	lhbrx 6, 0, 4
	sthbrx 6, 0, 5

=== an atomic increment loop
retry:
	lwarx 3, 0, 4
	addi 3, 3, 1
	stwcx. 3, 0, 4
	bne retry
	blr

=== halves of a value that resolves while assembling
# A label difference, and a symbol set after its use, reach layout as fixups
# rather than constants, and still need @ha arithmetic rather than truncation.
start:
	lis 3, (end - start)@ha
	addi 3, 3, (end - start)@l
	lis 4, (end - start)@h
	lis 5, later@ha
	.space 0x800c
end:
	blr
	.set later, 0x12348000
